SELECT operate_log.id, password_identity.identifier AS login_code, `user`.display_name AS login_name, operate_log.module, operate_log.title, operate_log.resource, operate_log.ip, operate_log.type, operate_log.exception, operate_log.create_time FROM operate_log LEFT JOIN `user` ON operate_log.user_id = `user`.id LEFT JOIN user_identity password_identity ON password_identity.user_id = `user`.id AND password_identity.identity_type = 'password' AND password_identity.status = 1
operate_log.is_delete = 0 AND operate_log.event_type = 'AUTHENTICATION'
AND operate_log.create_time >= #{req.startTime}
AND operate_log.create_time <= #{req.endTime}
AND password_identity.identifier LIKE CONCAT('%', #{req.loginCode}, '%')
AND `user`.display_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{req.loginName}, '%')
AND operate_log.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{req.title}, '%')
ORDER BY operate_log.id DESC
